# Skill Composition Catalog

Generated from `docs/governance/skill-composition.yaml`. It records route navigation and composition suggestions, not installation dependencies, runtime orchestration, or quality scores. The Router's independent-install reference lives in its own `reference.md`.

## Routes / Recipes

| Route | Applicable phase | Primary Skill (path) | Optional Skill (path) | Not for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `new-feature-quality` — New feature quality readiness | Requirements analysis / test design | `requirements-analysis` (`skills/en/testing-types/requirements-analysis`) | `test-strategy` (`skills/en/testing-types/test-strategy`) | Does not replace execution by a concrete test type or tool; Does not invent acceptance criteria when inputs are missing |
| `api-delivery` — API delivery | API design / implementation / verification | `api-testing` (`skills/en/testing-types/api-testing`) | `api-contract-testing` (`skills/en/testing-types/api-contract-testing`) | Does not replace execution by a concrete API client or framework; Does not treat contract checks as complete business acceptance |
| `change-regression` — Change and regression | Change analysis / regression planning | `change-impact-analysis` (`skills/en/testing-types/change-impact-analysis`) | `regression-test-selection` (`skills/en/testing-types/regression-test-selection`) | Does not claim that regression tests have been executed; Does not provide precise impact conclusions without change evidence |
| `performance-decision` — Performance decision | Performance modeling / result analysis | `performance-workload-modeling` (`skills/en/testing-types/performance-workload-modeling`) | `performance-result-analysis` (`skills/en/testing-types/performance-result-analysis`) | Does not replace execution by a load-testing tool or target environment; Does not treat a static workload model as runtime results |
| `ai-feature-validation` — AI feature validation | AI feature design / evaluation planning | `ai-feature-testing` (`skills/en/testing-types/ai-feature-testing`) | `llm-testing` (`skills/en/testing-types/llm-testing`) | Does not claim model effectiveness without a model, data, and target environment; Does not treat prompt suggestions as business acceptance or security conclusions |
